title: Round Display Safe-Area Layout Planner
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Examine candidate feature bounding boxes placed on a 240x240 round display buffer, and distinguish safe placements (fully inside the visible circle) from unsafe placements (clipped by the circular boundary), in order to plan facial feature layout.

learningObjectives: Examine candidate feature bounding boxes placed on a 240x240 round display buffer, and distinguish safe placements (fully inside the visible circle) from unsafe placements (clipped by the circular boundary), in order to plan facial feature layout.
